name: io.github.Nuruvala/grok-build-mcp-server
title: Grok Build
description: Run the Grok Build CLI as MCP tools: agent runs with live progress, code review, web research.

environmentVariables.name: GROK_BINARY
environmentVariables.description: Path to the grok executable. Only needed when grok is not on PATH.

environmentVariables.name: GROK_MCP_PERMISSION_CEILING
environmentVariables.description: Highest permission level any call may request. Granted once at registration and never prompts again.

environmentVariables.name: GROK_MCP_DEFAULT_PERMISSION
environmentVariables.description: Permission level used when a call specifies none. Must be at or below the ceiling.

environmentVariables.name: GROK_MCP_DEFAULT_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model used when a call omits one.

environmentVariables.name: GROK_MCP_DEFAULT_EFFORT
environmentVariables.description: Reasoning effort used when a call omits one.

environmentVariables.name: GROK_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Wall-clock kill for a single run, in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: GROK_MCP_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for background job records. Defaults to $XDG_STATE_HOME/grok-mcp.

environmentVariables.name: GROK_MCP_MAX_CONCURRENT_RUNS
environmentVariables.description: Background runs alive at once. Use off, none, or unlimited for no cap.

environmentVariables.name: STRUCTURED_CONTENT_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Emit structuredContent alongside _meta. Off by default because some clients mishandle it.
